text:
Column | https://column.com | backend, tooling and/or infra | San Francisco (in-person)

Column is building the financial operating system to power the movement and holding of money across the globe. We own a nationally chartered bank and build every aspect of our technology in house. We move trillions of dollars in volume annually, power top tech companies like Ramp, Bilt, Mercury and Brex -- along with hundreds of other banks and companies throughout the world. If you want to understand how financial services _really_ works, we're the best place in the world to work.

We're all in person in San Francisco, the stack is all Go, and are looking for backend and infra engineers to join!
